mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_device WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} LIMIT 1)

SELECT profile_id, partner_user_id, device_no, system_platform, app_name, app_version, package_name, phone_brand, phone_brand_model, mac, system_version, delivery_platform, cpu_cores, memory_total, sd_card_total, ad_id, idfv, idfa, ext_param, device_json, last_request_id FROM user_device WHERE device_no = #{deviceNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_device ( profile_id, partner_user_id, device_no, system_platform, app_name, app_version, package_name, phone_brand, phone_brand_model, mac, system_version, delivery_platform, cpu_cores, memory_total, sd_card_total, ad_id, idfv, idfa, ext_param, device_json, last_request_id ) VALUES ( #{profileId}, #{partnerUserId}, #{deviceNo}, #{systemPlatform}, #{appName}, #{appVersion}, #{packageName}, #{phoneBrand}, #{phoneBrandModel}, #{mac}, #{systemVersion}, #{deliveryPlatform}, #{cpuCores}, #{memoryTotal}, #{sdCardTotal}, #{adId}, #{idfv}, #{idfa}, #{extParam}, #{deviceJson}, #{lastRequestId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_id=VALUES(profile_id), partner_user_id=VALUES(partner_user_id), system_platform=VALUES(system_platform), app_name=VALUES(app_name), app_version=VALUES(app_version), package_name=VALUES(package_name), phone_brand=VALUES(phone_brand), phone_brand_model=VALUES(phone_brand_model), mac=VALUES(mac), system_version=VALUES(system_version), delivery_platform=VALUES(delivery_platform), cpu_cores=VALUES(cpu_cores), memory_total=VALUES(memory_total), sd_card_total=VALUES(sd_card_total), ad_id=VALUES(ad_id), idfv=VALUES(idfv), idfa=VALUES(idfa), ext_param=VALUES(ext_param), device_json=VALUES(device_json), last_request_id=VALUES(last_request_id), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
